text:
Sam: Quick follow-up from the KV-cache leak postmortem — want to consolidate owners, timelines, and recurring detection items. I’ll start a rollup here so we can point the execs at progress. Planning to sync Wed 11am PT.

Priya: I can take profiling and heap captures. I’ll run a full pprof sweep on the 3 worst-replicas today and upload outputs.

Priya: Command I’ll use:```sudo perf record -F 99 -p $(pgrep runtime) -- sleep 60
pprof --alloc_space --inuse_space /proc/<pid>/maps > /tmp/pprof-alloc.pb.gz```

deploy-bot: upload complete — s3://redwood-profiles/1968001234/pprof-priya-1.pb.gz :white_check_mark:

Jorge: I’ll own GC params + eviction tuning. Initial hypothesis is fragmentation from mixed-size slab allocations. Plan: try slab_size=64K -> 32K canary on a staging shard and measure RSS growth over 6h.

Liz: I’ll add a short-term safety guard: per-shard hard limit at 90% of container mem + automated restart window (3 restarts -> quarantine). ETA: EOD tomorrow.

Alyssa: I’ll create a recurring alert and a regression detector. Query: "delta(sum(kv_cache_rss) by (shard), 1h) > 0.15 * total_mem" — will wire to PagerDuty with an escalation for repeat offenders. ETA: 48h.

Sam: Nice. Can we enumerate concrete action items so we can mark done in the postmortem?

Priya: Action 1 (owner: Priya) — run targeted pprof, upload traces, share links + diff vs baseline. ETA: 24h.

Jorge: Action 2 (owner: Jorge) — run slab size canary and GC param sweep on staging (documented perf matrix). ETA: 72h.

Liz: Action 3 (owner: Liz) — implement hard-limit guard + kube restart policy and add annotation for quarantine. ETA: 48h.

Alyssa: Action 4 (owner: Alyssa) — implement regression detection query, add runbook steps for repeated alerts, add a synthetic load job that exercises hot prefixes weekly. ETA: 48h.

Sam: Action 5 (owner: Sam) — coordinate postmortem update, extract 3 slide summary for ops lead and customers who asked about impact. ETA: 5 business days.

Priya: Quick note — I found a small reproducer that leaks when prefix eviction happens during a concurrent compaction. Sharing stack traces briefly:
```
# short stack (allocated hotspots)
runtime.mallocgc
runtime.growslice
kvcache.Put
kvcache.compactWorker
```

Jorge: That compaction concurrency pattern matches earlier fragmentation incidents (see 1938456789). I’ll add a regression test that randomizes compaction timing.

Liz: For telemetry, please add these extra tags: shard_id, replica_zone, model_id so we can correlate to high-cardinality traffic.

Alyssa: Also adding a daily cron job that fetches top-10 evicted prefixes and computes a churn score — if churn > 0.2 for 3 days we auto-open a ticket.

Sam: Good. Anyone want to take temporary postmortem ownership for weekly check-ins until things are stable? 

Jorge: I can run the first two weeks of check-ins. Will post minutes in this thread.

Priya: I’ll drop the pprof links here once uploads are indexed.

deploy-bot: alert: OOM event on shard-7 at 2026-11-04T03:12:18Z — process killed, exit code 137 — reproducer attached to s3://incidents/1968001234/oom-shard7.log

Sam: Thanks bots — that OOM log will be critical for the RCA. Let’s keep action owners updating the postmortem doc. I’ll push the initial action table before EOD. :thumbsup:
